deviceDescription: A rotary phone that plays trivia questions from phonequiz.maghen.com. Wi-Fi, hostname and time zone are under Device & Network; which questions it plays is under Application Settings.

appSettings.help: Saving restarts the quiz, which then downloads its questions again.

items.label: Server address
items.help: The Phone Quiz admin site the phone downloads its questions from.

items.label: Phone key
items.help: From the admin site: Phone keys, then Copy key. It decides which question group this phone plays.

items.label: Shuffle questions
items.help: Off plays the questions in the order set in the admin site.
